problem:
Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
x=5-{t}^{2},\,y={t}^{2}-3,\,0\le t\le 3
$$
worked_solution:
We need to create a table of values and then sketch the curve. First, we work out the $x$-values using the formula $x=5-{t}^{2}.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $5$ | $4$ | $1$ | $-4$ |
| $y$ | $$ | $$ | $$ | $$ |

$$

$$

Now, we work out the $y$ values using $y={t}^{2}-3.$ This gives

| **$t$** | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $x$ | $5$ | $4$ | $1$ | $-4$ |
| $y$ | $-3$ | $-2$ | $1$ | $6$ |

$$

$$

Plotting these points, we obtain the following curve:
